title: Sea level and deep thermocline in GLORYS
query: Using matched daily GLORYS potential temperature and sea-surface height in the Gulf of Mexico (98–82 W, 18–30 N) from July 2011 to August 2015, estimate the depth of the 6 degree C isotherm where it is bracketed. Quantify its relationship with sea-surface height, compare the regions west/east of 90 W, and test whether the association remains after removing calendar-month means. Use only the supplied public data and coordinate-defined masks; no private profiles, author simulations or additional measurements are required. Report methods, executed numerical evidence, a concise interpretation and an editable analysis.ipynb. The reference paper motivates the diagnostic, but its observational values are not target answers for this adapted input.
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
